rules.title: App caches
rules.note: Apps rebuild their caches when needed. Caches of running apps are skipped.

rules.title: App logs
rules.note: Diagnostic logs older than a week.

rules.title: Xcode build data
rules.note: Build products and indexes. Xcode rebuilds them on the next build.

rules.title: Xcode archives
rules.note: Archived builds you may need for crash symbolication or resubmission.

rules.title: iPhone and iPad backups
rules.note: Local device backups. Deleting one cannot be undone once the Trash is emptied.
